oneOf.description: A completed CLI session MUST deliver api_key only while the original authorizing membership remains active and bound to the same organization and the issued key remains active, unrevoked, and unexpired. Membership and key state MUST be row-locked in the same serializable delivery transaction. API-key expiry MUST be evaluated after the referenced key row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same serializable transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden. The decrypted api_key MUST hash to the referenced active key_id before delivery or erasure. API-key delivery is one-time. Session expiry MUST be evaluated after the session row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same transaction for authorization and polling; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden.
